propositions: The bedrock_model_id field is parsed from REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID environment variable and [tool.rebar.llm] config table but is never read by any code in src/ or tests/
The actual Bedrock model identifier is carried by cfg.model as a provider-prefixed string (bedrock:<inference-profile-id>) which is parsed by providers.py and tested as the working path
Setting REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID produces silent no-op behavior with no warning or error, despite being documented in docs/env-vars.md
The bedrock_model_id field exists only in the unsubmitted change 1043 and has never shipped to production
The field cannot serve as a second model knob for per-pass model requirements because it is unwired, and wiring it would create config ambiguity between two paths to the same value
